speaker: Enzo Maresca
quote_text:
Thank you. Okay, who wants to get us underway?  Peter. Hi, Enzo. I suppose as a result goes,  
and in terms of not having to use all  your key players on the bench as well,  
3-0 first leg victory, it's as good as it gets,  I think? Yeah, we planned the game to try to  
have our best player for this game and to  give also a chance to the rest players to  
recover the energy. And at the end, yeah, I think  has been overall professional performance. Good  
result. Probably second-half, we were much better  compared to the first half for different reasons.  
I said many times that we need to learn how  to play different kind of games. You know,  
when you face Tottenham, we said many times that  they tried wide pressing, there are more space,  
but when they sit back, you have to be more quick  on the ball. You have to try to have a shot from  
outside the box because they are all inside  the box. So if you don't shoot, it's difficult.  
And then the first goal, I think, came from  Reece's shot, you know, rebound, player was there,  
Ty was there. So yeah. And in terms of that first  half, is it just a lack of tempo that was missing,  
really? It's not easy because it happens every  time. If you watch last night, I watch Aston  
Villa, PSG and from television you see lack of  tempo. But it's because it's what it is. You have  
to try to find solution. It's a different game  and you have to learn. And I think we need to,  
we have to learn to play that kind of games  against teams that they sit back. How you can  
learn. For sure you can be more quick on the ball.  For sure you have to take some more risk when you  
arrive at the edge. You have to try to shot like  we scored the first one. So yeah. Liam. Hi Enzo,  
how pleased are you for Tyrique George to have  a moment like that? He's had a few assists, he's  
been gaining in confidence in this competition and  in the cups, but you also shuffled the positions  
around a little bit at half-time, didn't you,  and put him as the nine? How do you feel like  
he? No, really, yeah. Happy, first of all, for the  Chelsea Academy. Because he's one of our boy from  
the academy, so very happy for him. He was quite  good first half, take responsibility. Second-half  
in the middle probably was a bit better. But  the one that I fall in love tonight is Josh  
Acheampong, because for me potentially he can be  a fantastic player, top player for this club, for  
the football in general. And a good player show  you that can play in different position and he can  
do good. He was fullback, good, midfielder, good,  central defender, good. So it's not about, yeah,  
I play in that position, all in that position.  If you are a good player, you can be in different  
position. And tonight I fall in love with Josh  because to be honest, since we start, I'm in  
love with him, but tonight he's sure that he can  be a very good player for this club. Do you see  
him that way for the long term where situationally  you will move him around and ask different things  
of him? He can be good in different positions.  And the best thing from Josh also is that he's  
open. He wants to learn. Okay, fullback, yeah,  yeah, no problem. What do I have to do? Perfect.  
Midfielder, what do I have to do? And this is a  player that they are good players. They want to  
play in all positions. They want to learn. And  Josh is doing that since we start. We use him in  
the way we are using Malo, Reece, since we start,  Cucurella, fullback inside, central defender  
inside. And he was very good tonight. Thank  you. Question over here in the middle, please.  
Coach, congratulations for winning.  I wanted to ask about the fans and  
the atmosphere. At the stadium. What  can you say about the fans of Legia,  
and did you expect this well  of a fan and atmosphere?  
Yeah, I expect the environment and the reason  why I said yesterday in the press conference,  
I watch different games, especially at home,  and I know how is the environment, so I expect  
that. And I also said to the players that it's  a privilege to play this kind of games with this  
environment. So I think we dealt quite well. We'll  do three more questions, one, two, and three.  
Hi Enzo. First of all, congrats for the  result. Today we've seen Jorgensen on the goal,  
and my question is, right now, Chelsea is rotating  of the goalkeeper position. And do you plan to  
do the same thing in the future, let's say in  the next season? In terms of keepers? Yes. No,  
I said already many times. Our number one choice  is Robert. But in some moment of the season,  
he needs rest. So we decide to change with  Filip. But now Robert is good, Filip is good  
and hopefully we're going to continue in the  both competition and they can share games. Hi,  
just a quick one on Cole Palmer. Was the plan  always to take him off at half time or is there  
any kind of knock? Because there was a period  in the game where it looked like he might be  
struggling a little bit. No, no, no. We plan for  him and for Tosin, 45 minutes. So everything was  
planned. And just a word on Christopher Nkunku as  well. Unfortunately he missed the penalty. What do  
you think he needs to do to really gain confidence  and get going in the running for the season? Yeah,  
probably in this moment it's lack of confidence  and the reason why is because he's missing goal  
or penalty like tonight. But the only way to deal  with that is to work hard every day. Because when  
you work hard, for sure the reward is important.  The problem is when you stop to work. And the good  
thing about Christo is that it's working well  every day. Okay, thanks everyone. Thank you.
title: Enzo Maresca post-match press conference | Legia Warsaw 0-3 Chelsea | Europa Conference League
